items.area: Native multi-asset ProductCapabilities and cross-product authority boundary
items.resolution: Closed after exact-head certification on f9ec065302a798a48a51b092fd6835a46416a2af: crypto ProductCapabilities is bound to exact broker asset evidence, its fingerprint is persisted in the durable lifecycle and prepared package, the last-write Final Guard requires fresh CRYPTO ProductCapabilities bound to fresh asset evidence and the same stable product contract, and permanent execution/product CI scans the complete alpaca_paper_crypto_*.py production family for cross-product authority leakage while preserving the certified US-equity session/bracket contract.

items.area: Crypto protective lifecycle after confirmed entry fills
items.resolution: Closed after exact-head 7/7 certification on 392dd22beea2571681aa7582a8c6408ecd8a5776: protective SELL authority is bound to the exact confirmed net-long exposure and separate risk-reducing Safety decision; PRE_CONSUME is durably checkpointed before human-authority consumption; the same attempt is then bound through OMS SUBMITTING, durable PROTECTION_SUBMISSION_UNKNOWN and role-specific Final Guard PRE_IO before exactly one delegated PAPER transport call. Fresh protection evidence is additionally bound to the same stable PAPER account_reference and credential_reference, and those identities plus fresh-account/position fingerprints survive crash/restart inside the tamper-evident checkpoint. No equity bracket authority, blind retry, Mac execution surface or LIVE authority is introduced.

items.area: Crypto PAPER writer idempotency, UNKNOWN-before-I/O and reconciliation
items.resolution: Closed after exact-head 7/7 certification on 392dd22beea2571681aa7582a8c6408ecd8a5776: enabled crypto writes reject raw/default or role-mismatched transports before lifecycle mutation or I/O, with ENTRY and PROTECTION as the only sanctioned nominal Final-Guard transports. The exact PAPER /v2/orders write remains one-shot with durable UNKNOWN-before-I/O and no blind retry. GET-only reconciliation is bound to the durable client_order_id, exact position truth and credential provenance. If the exact order lookup is HTTP 404, the original POST outcome remains unresolved, the gateway still performs the exact position GET, and a separate tamper-evident UNKNOWN recovery path can only HALT remaining exposure or reach FLAT_RECONCILED after fresh same-account all-account evidence proves zero positions and zero open orders. The original attempt_count=1 and client_order_id are preserved and retry_authorized remains false.

items.area: Crypto 24/7 PAPER qualification and residual-risk evidence
items.next_action: Structural writer, protection and UNKNOWN/reconciliation authority is now certified. Next, only under explicit human approval, run a bounded PAPER qualification campaign across multiple UTC/liquidity/weekend conditions and persist fills, fees, spread, slippage, protection acknowledgements/outcomes, reconciliation, stop-limit residual-risk evidence and any PROTECTION_AT_RISK behavior. Connectivity or structural certification alone cannot close this debt or support profitability claims, and no LIVE authority may be introduced.

items.area: Native Multi-Asset Mac Control Center and operator UAT
items.next_action: Code and dual-architecture Mac FULL artifacts now certify the localhost Multi-Asset Hub, first-class Equities/Crypto routes, ephemeral credentials, direct /usr/bin/open browser handoff with safe fallback, no hidden crypto/equity POST path and ARM64/x86_64 install/self-heal. Keep this debt OPEN until the operator performs a final real-Mac UAT on the final installable head and records the corrected browser handoff and primary user flow as observed evidence.
